title: Preserve accepted outward wheel input through held paint handoffs

scope.subject: Carry one bounded existing response-distance coordinate across real Approach→System and System→Galaxy paint fences; use the same camera and restore retained Galaxy bridge.

research_summary: Exact PR #186 V10 c4c45484 full hosted CI run 45824370858, job 139924961777 and artifact 15118943962: both repeated WebGL round trips stall at System target 1.000 with native Galaxy 1.000 despite twenty +96 wheel events. The Approach wait stores only the clamped System coordinate. Exact uploaded V10 dist 15118718596 reproduces with 14 trusted outward Chromium wheel events delivered while the real Approach renderer is held. Reuse existing inversion of the scale response, the single outward carry coordinate, paint/epoch gate and damped renderer loop. Preserve actual endpoint/trajectory and resource witnesses; no new camera, timer queue, or relaxed budget.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the installed scale renderers and retained native YEIS bridge; the defect is in the existing coordinator consuming input while waiting on a paint.
Reuse the already-present R3F applied-pose and phase/epoch protocol, not an independent update loop.
Keep the adopted camera-controls owner and the same clamp/fit geometry, including the inverse System trajectory.
Retain the latest bounded outward coordinate in the existing slot; transfer it only after each matching rendered endpoint.

sources.finding: Native Galaxy and System scenes remain in place.
Existing frame callback provides seconds delta before the single CinematicPipeline draw.
Installed controls remain sole pose authority, via immediate pose and established settlement tolerances.
Installed damp uses exponential decay with explicit delta, without event queues or new packages.
Existing Chromium lane can generate trusted wheel input and sample actual camera distance, angle and frame continuity with render diagnostics.

candidates.reason: Uses the existing wheel response map, one carried outward value and existing R3F pose/epoch fences; retains original camera-control geometry.
candidates.name: Existing Frame Damp Camera Controls

candidates.reason: Shot animation transfers before the true endpoint and hides dropped input without fixing the coordinator.
candidates.name: Camera Controls Direct Shot Smooth Time

candidates.reason: Immediate ownership swap makes the endpoint and bounded intermediate frames unobservable.
candidates.name: Existing Coordinate Only Direct Apply

decision.rationale: Consume the same damped camera trajectory and exact painted handoff; reuse the current one-slot global raw coordinate and existing epoch cancellation. Keep all WebGL checks and physical input oracles.

higher_level_tradeoffs.reason: A direct camera-controls shot transition changes authored geometry, logarithmic projection and exact renderer matching; preserve the original route and interpolate its existing coordinate in R3F.

decision.fallback: Retain the last published candidate instead of weakening WebGL resource, trajectory or input budgets if the same-path fixes do not validate.
